question: 任務狀態分布
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tasks WHERE company_id=:company_id GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

question: 各部門逾期未完成數
sql: SELECT p.department, COUNT(*) AS overdue_count FROM tasks t JOIN people p ON p.company_id=t.company_id AND p.person_id=t.owner_id WHERE t.company_id=:company_id AND t.due_date<:as_of AND t.status<>'done' GROUP BY p.department ORDER BY overdue_count DESC,p.department

question: 各專案完成率
sql: SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status='done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_count, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN status='done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS completion_pct FROM tasks WHERE company_id=:company_id GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id

question: 超支專案及超支金額
sql: SELECT p.project_id,p.budget_twd,SUM(e.amount_twd) AS actual_twd,SUM(e.amount_twd)-p.budget_twd AS overrun_twd FROM projects p JOIN expenses e ON e.company_id=p.company_id AND e.project_id=p.project_id WHERE p.company_id=:company_id GROUP BY p.project_id,p.budget_twd HAVING SUM(e.amount_twd)>p.budget_twd ORDER BY overrun_twd DESC,p.project_id

sql: SELECT project_id,SUM(sample_count) AS samples,SUM(defect_count) AS defects,ROUND(100.0*SUM(defect_count)/SUM(sample_count),2) AS defect_pct FROM quality_checks WHERE company_id=:company_id GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY defect_pct DESC,project_id

question: 各月各類已入帳成本
sql: SELECT SUBSTR(booked_date,1,7) AS month,category,SUM(amount_twd) AS amount_twd FROM expenses WHERE company_id=:company_id GROUP BY SUBSTR(booked_date,1,7),category ORDER BY month,category

question: 尚未結案的高風險清單
sql: SELECT risk_id,project_id,cause,action FROM risks WHERE company_id=:company_id AND severity='high' AND status='open' ORDER BY risk_id

question: 未完成工作最多的前五位負責人
sql: SELECT p.person_id,p.name,COUNT(*) AS open_tasks FROM people p JOIN tasks t ON t.company_id=p.company_id AND t.owner_id=p.person_id WHERE t.company_id=:company_id AND t.status<>'done' GROUP BY p.person_id,p.name ORDER BY open_tasks DESC,p.person_id LIMIT 5

question: 已完成任務工時超估清單
sql: SELECT task_id,estimated_hours,actual_hours,actual_hours-estimated_hours AS extra_hours FROM tasks WHERE company_id=:company_id AND status='done' AND actual_hours>estimated_hours ORDER BY extra_hours DESC,task_id

question: 各專案未取消的採購承諾金額
sql: SELECT project_id,SUM(amount_twd) AS committed_twd FROM purchase_orders WHERE company_id=:company_id AND status<>'cancelled' GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id

question: 本週到期未完成任務
sql: SELECT task_id,due_date,status FROM tasks WHERE company_id=:company_id AND due_date BETWEEN '2026-10-05' AND '2026-10-11' AND status<>'done' ORDER BY due_date,task_id

question: 各專案退回與受阻任務數
sql: SELECT project_id,SUM(CASE WHEN status='rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count,SUM(CASE WHEN status='blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked_count FROM tasks WHERE company_id=:company_id GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id

question: 尚未收貨但未逾期的訂單
sql: SELECT order_id,promised_date,amount_twd FROM purchase_orders WHERE company_id=:company_id AND status='pending' AND promised_date>=:as_of ORDER BY promised_date,order_id

question: 零不良批次數
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_defect_batches FROM quality_checks WHERE company_id=:company_id AND defect_count=0
